_comment: Overnight bsidectf A/B for the dedicated flag-runner role (0.9.7, commit b3e3a3ef code; binary hash-label lags one commit, string-verified). 3v3 (soak-bots.cfg), full 3-map rotation (Nightmarecastle/mysterious_isle/batteriesincluded), 15-min rounds. Interleaved A(runner on)/B(runner off/legacy) in 6-round blocks (= 2 full rotations each) so each condition sees every map equally across the night. Theory under test: a dedicated, powerup-disciplined flag-getter improves conversion on contested routes (batteries Red was 1 grab/8rnd, its attackers pinned on the room-118 powerup trap). Judge by flag_conversion.py per-map/team, A vs B; split the log at the '$nav runner on|off' echoes.
